Fostering developer innovation

Developer Students Club, SRM IST Ramapuram provides a collaborative space for students to learn, build, and grow together, bridging the gap between theory and practice.

Hands-on learning & workshops

Master modern frameworks, tools, and platforms through peer-led study groups and interactive tech workshops.

Real-world project development

Apply theoretical concepts to solve real local problems, collaborate in teams, and build impactful open-source projects.

Global network & mentorship

Connect with developers worldwide, learn from industry experts, and prepare for a career in the tech industry.

Built by Builders, for Builders

Home to the top developers, engineers, and builders on campus. We engineer production-grade systems, conquer elite hackathons, and build the future together.
